rationale: The agent failed to correctly handle the user's request to cancel the air purifier from the order. According to the policy, the user was permitted to cancel the entire order since it was still pending; however, the agent incorrectly informed the user that cancelling only one item was not possible and guided them towards an option that did not align with the user's request. Additionally, when the user opted not to cancel the order, the conversation ended without any action taken, which also does not satisfy the outcome requirement fully, as the initial request wasn't fulfilled by the agent.
